title: HSBC rolls out its first stablecoin to over 3 million everyday app users
summary: HSBC and Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint received Hong Kong’s first stablecoin issuer licenses in April. Anchorpoint began rolling out HKDAP in August.

title: Sweden’s central bank revives e-krona debate as stablecoins and digital euro loom
summary: The Riksbank sees an e-krona as critical to securing national payments and monetary control.

title: India's largest exchange denies hack after sleuths pointed to $16 million in suspicious outflows
summary: CoinDCX denies its active wallets were hacked after sleuths flagged $16 million in outflows from addresses linked to the India-based exchange.

title: Polymarket has reportedly fired its marketing chief, also a close friend of the CEO
summary: Matthew Modabber was reportedly ousted after an internal probe of several instances of misconduct, according to the New York Post.

title: Ethereum delays Glamsterdam test after security devs flag risk to existing contracts
summary: Developers canceled Monday's Hoodi activation after researchers showed how new gas rules could let smart contracts permanently record failed operations.
